text:
tyler: Heads up — Go SDK v0.9.1 shipped a header rename and it's tripping quota/routing in staging. Not many errors but a bunch of requests are landing in the fallback route. Anyone else seeing this?

marco: which header did we change? I remember renaming one for consistency across SDKs last week.

tyler: The SDK is now emitting "X-Redwood-Route" but our router/quota layers still expect "X-Redwood-Routing-Policy". Example from a captured request:```
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
X-Redwood-Route: paid-low-latency
```

marco: ugh, that was my change — I thought all servers were updated to support the short name. I only updated Go because it felt cleaner.

soumya: The platform currently checks for X-Redwood-Routing-Policy for routing decisions and the quota sharder uses the same key to attribute usage. If the header is absent we fallback to default routing which triggers conservative quotas.

jen: We're also seeing telemetry events with route="unknown" in the console, looks like some of those are from customers hitting staging. This will confuse investigations if not surfaced.

release-bot: release v0.9.1 (go-sdk) published — tag: v0.9.1 — 2026-03-17T22:03:00Z

marco: Plan options: 1) hotfix Go to emit both headers (old + new), 2) roll back rename in Go, or 3) change platform to accept the new header only. I prefer 1 for fastest compatibility.

tyler: Emitting both headers sounds safest. Can Go set both simultaneously so other SDKs can migrate later?

marco: Yep. Proposed patch:```go
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Routing-Policy", route)
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Route", route) // backwards compat
```
I'll open a PR and cut v0.9.2 immediately if y'all are 👍

soumya: Platform will add a temporary fallback: if X-Redwood-Route present and X-Redwood-Routing-Policy absent, treat them equivalent. We'll also add a short-lived alert for any requests where both headers differ (possible spoofing) and a dashboard tile showing "route header source" so ops can see whether SDK or console set the route. Deploy window: 1 hour.

jen: Devex will add a blurb to the release notes and a console banner for users of staging explaining the header mismatch and that a patch is rolling out. Also will add a small telemetry mapping so route attribution in the console prefers the router header but falls back to the SDK header.

tyler: Timeline recap: Marco cuts v0.9.2 (emit both) in ~2h, platform deploys fallback + alert in ~1h, devex posts release note + console banner after platform deploy. Can we keep the fallback live for 48 hours and then remove?

marco: yep, I'll aim for the patch in the next 90 minutes. PR link when ready.

soumya: I'll create a dashboard card and an ops alert:
- condition: any request with X-Redwood-Route present and X-Redwood-Routing-Policy missing OR headers mismatched
- notify: #eng-oncall, #platform-ops
- cooldown: 10m

jen: Also adding a tiny UX tweak to traffic view: show "route source" column (router/sdk/console) so PMs can see who is driving routing choices.

tyler: Nice. Sounds like a good minimal blast radius approach. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
